title: SPORE TWO?
author: blwrks
selftext:
since ai can be used in every game now, could someone create a sequel for Spore , since the company has been shut down.

It would be nice to see a new addition for Spore.

replies.author: blwrks
replies.body: just create a whole new game genuinely

replies.author: RemarkableWish2508
replies.body:
At this point, we need another one: AI stage.

Have the creatures train their own LLMs based on their own language, train an AGI, and see whether they decide to make their own "Spore" or get replaced by whatever robots they build.

replies.author: WalterMittyRocketMan
replies.body: Spore was genuinely mind blowing when I first played as a kid. I’ll say the game felt a bit “shallow” at points, but to your point, I don’t even know what a spore 2 would look like or what you would really add. It’s already basically fully customizable so I don’t know that more options would add much to the game
